0.original: Thancred has a task for you.

24.original: Search for enthralled civilians in the Derelicts.

26.original: Search for enthralled civilians in the Understory.

27.original: Administer dream powder to the amiable maiden.

28.original: Search for enthralled civilians in the Canopy.

29.original: Administer dream powder to the free citizen.

48.original: My thanks again, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We will seek out the wounded and render what aid we can.

49.original: Some folk managed to escape the mind control but were caught in the chaos. We'll make sure they receive treatment as well.

50.original: It's all right. You're safe now.

52.original: Bereft of leadership, the soldiers have lost the will to fight. They pose no threat to us.

53.original: So this was how the citizens lived─the Eulmoran dream. They are in for quite a rude awakening.

54.original: So, here is some dream powder.

55.original: We're administering it to the enthralled to keep them calm until they can receive proper attention. I would appreciate it if you could assist with this task.

56.original: Now, those affected are scattered all over the city. I suggest starting your search at the Derelicts and working your way up.

57.original: When you are done, be sure to let Ryne know.

58.original: O Lord Vauthry... You are...my daily meol...

62.original: Ahhh...it hurts... Please, Lord Vauthry...take away the pain...

63.original: You're the kind soul who saved me from falling to my death!

64.original: M-My mistress, she's been injured! Please help her, I beg you!

65.original: Please, is there nothing you can do for her?

67.original: She's...sleeping. A medicine to help her rest while she awaits treatment, you say?

68.original: Oh, thank you so much! When she began acting strangely, I didn't know what to do...

70.original: I won't leave my mistress's side.

72.original: <snort> Where did you fly to...my sweet canary...?

75.original: I've just finished aiding this man. Now, for the next one...

76.original: More out in the Derelicts and below, you say? So many of them...

77.original: But Minfilia entrusted this power to me. I won't rest until I've helped everyone.

79.original: I can bring the enthralled to you.

80.original: I'll go and see to the wounded.

81.original: Oh, that would certainly make it easier for me to work.

82.original: Thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'll do my best to keep pace.

83.original: I'm sure Alphinaud and Alisaie would appreciate the help.

84.original: And should you find other enthralled civilians, please see that they are brought to me.
